Targeting yourself with Critical Analysis lets you also trigger a mutagenic transformation, warping your body for 1 hour and amplifying your geneticist discoveries. While transformed you gain the following:

  • Taking the Attack action lets you attack twice instead of once.
  • Your Strength score is replaced by your Critical Analysis score.
  • Your AC gains a bonus equal to half your Critical Analysis ability modifier (minimum +1), unless it already benefits from that modifier.

You can end the transformation early as a bonus action, and it also ends early if you're incapacitated or die. You can transform twice, regaining all uses on finishing a long rest.
